author: Mark Atwood
text:
INDEPENDENT AUDIT (second worker session, verified against live HEAD 6e73cf4ebb) — corrects the close reason above, which describes the discarded 9f859a8a2b-era tree, not this repository:

1. NO vector JSON changes were needed at HEAD. All three gaps were already repaired BEFORE this bead was filed (15:48Z): 7a key orders [lat,lon,ts,node,type]->[ts,lat,lon,node,type] and [msg,ts,...]->[ts,msg,...] landed in ab47a726ef (08-26); 7b sos_in_window 0->2 landed in ab47a726ef (confessions posts_in_window 0->2 too) and sos now 3600001->3601000 in 4921cfd8f4 (08-28 07:01Z); the 6 xfail(strict) flips landed in 4921cfd8f4 (no xfail markers remain on these vectors).
2. 7c: the "pins 15->16 / 20->21" change in the close reason is NOT in the tree — confessions_rate.json still pins 15/20, and the implementation at HEAD (confessions.py:335,339) uses math.ceil, which returns exactly 15/20. The old int(remaining)+1 impl (9f859a8a2b confessions.py:137,142 — the line refs cited in the close reason) was replaced by math.ceil in ab47a726ef. Pins and impl AGREE at 15/20; applying the close reason's 16/21 edit now would make the vectors provably wrong.
3. External oracles (test-integrity): python cbor2.dumps(canonical=True) reproduces all three pinned key orders exactly; rust lichen-link sos.rs SosAlert::to_canonical_cbor (RFC 8949 4.2.1 encoded-key-byte sort) independently yields the same order — codecs AGREE, no divergence bead.
4. Consumers green at HEAD 6e73cf4ebb: python test_security_app_vector_consumers.py 94 passed (incl. TestAllSecurityAppVectorsAccountedFor 18/10/11); test_vector_files_consume.py + test_vectors.py + test_vector_atomic_json.py 848 passed/1 skip/3 xfail (xfails = unrelated observe/RD vectors); test_confessions_resource.py 56 passed (loads confessions_rate.json); rust sos_origin_vectors 2 passed, sos_rate_limit_vectors 1 passed (drives all 10 vectors, asserts sos_in_window==2), sos_cbor_vectors 2 passed.
5. No commits made by this audit (nothing to fix); follow-up docstring nit filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-du20.
